reason: A node of the new design mounts the face handles of its four-side ports only while they are shown (a connection being drawn, the node selected or keyboard-focused) or while one of its connections uses that face; before, every node kept about eleven hidden handles mounted, each subscribed to the canvas store, which cost frame time during playback of a large diagram. Nothing a person sees or stores changes: hidden handles were invisible and take no pointer, the faces offered while drawing a connection and on a selected or focused node are the same, and a connection's face handle is always there to draw it.
